basis: Activating mineralocorticoid receptor disorder defines early severe hypertension with suppressed renin/aldosterone and pregnancy-associated hypokalemia.
Microcephaly, intellectual disability and diabetes occur in 80-99%. Hearing and dental abnormalities occur in fewer than 30%.
Acquired factor V deficiency is a coagulation disorder typically caused by neutralizing factor V autoantibodies.
Autoimmune injury to autonomic ganglia causes sympathetic and parasympathetic failure; gut, bladder and cardiovascular symptoms reflect autonomic dysfunction.
Myotonic skeletal muscle disorder defined by severe episodic neonatal laryngeal spasm and airway obstruction.
Severe microcephaly and skeletal malformations, particularly posterior rib-gap defects, define the syndrome.
Carcinoma originates in breast ductal epithelium; breast has no axis. Metastatic organ involvement is not inherent to this concept.
Papillary adenoma originates in extrahepatic bile ducts, which belong to the hepatic axis.
Benign neoplasm of the hard palate, an oral cavity site.
Inherited platelet production disorder with lifelong thrombocytopenia; hematologic malignancies are a separate predisposition outcome.
Cataracts, hearing impairment and nephrotic syndrome define the syndrome; enterocolitis is also a defining feature and qualifies without a numeric frequency.
Inherited vascular malformations define HHT; pulmonary AVMs occur in roughly 30-50% across HHT and are a major criterion. HHT4-specific frequency is uncertain.
Toxic or nutritional injury of the optic nerve causes visual loss; the optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis.
Congenital anterior segment dysgenesis with corneal opacity, adhesions, cataract and glaucoma; all are ocular.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability characterize clinically significant 18q duplication; variable skeletal and cardiac defects lack a reliable group-wide 30% rate.
Sterol transport disorder; hemolysis and macrothrombocytopenia occur in about 30%, with supplied HPO support. Coronary disease is separately coded; xanthomas need not impair skin.
Mumps virus infection characteristically causes parotid salivary gland inflammation. Neurologic injury and hearing loss are minority complications.
Inherited focal epilepsy, sometimes with focal cortical dysplasia; disease manifestations are neurologic.
Acute myeloid leukemia is a malignant disorder of marrow myeloid cells; leukemia alone does not qualify for the infectious_immune axis.
Y-chromosome microdeletion causes impaired spermatogenesis and male infertility; reproductive dysfunction alone has no axis.
Psychosexual desire disorder without an underlying physiologic disease or demonstrated damage to an organ axis.
Cytomegalovirus infection is defined by its infectious mechanism; no particular damaged organ is common across this broad concept.
Marfanoid skeletal habitus and joint hypermobility define the syndrome; the name alone does not establish Marfan-type aortic or ocular disease.
Cerebellar maldevelopment causes developmental impairment, seizures and ataxia. Scoliosis occurs in 2/5 (40%); eye movement abnormalities reflect cerebellar dysfunction.
Villous adenoma originates in the glandular epithelium of the duodenum.
